verdictEs: GE Tracker es una suite de flipping completa con alertas, calculadoras de margen con GE tax, watchlists y app móvil, pero las features avanzadas están detrás de la suscripción GE Tracker Gold. Wiki Prices es el feed de precios real-time gratuito, abierto y autoritativo de Weirdgloop — la misma fuente que GE Tracker usa por debajo. Si quieres tooling de flipping y pagas la sub, GE Tracker; si solo quieres el precio de un item gratis y de la fuente canónica, Wiki Prices.
verdictEn: GE Tracker is a full flipping suite with alerts, margin calculators that account for GE tax, watchlists, and a mobile app, but the advanced features sit behind the GE Tracker Gold subscription. Wiki Prices is Weirdgloop's free, open, authoritative real-time price feed — the same source GE Tracker pulls from underneath. If you want flipping tooling and will pay the sub, GE Tracker; if you just want an item's price for free from the canonical source, Wiki Prices.

useCases.reasonEn: GE Tracker offers dump/price alerts, watchlists, and margin and profit calculators that already subtract the GE tax. Wiki Prices shows prices and graphs but has no alerts or flipping tooling of that kind.
